BM25 filter with very high threshold filters out all pages

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ContentFilterKind, crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { bm25Query: "quantum physics", bm25Threshold: 100.0, contentFilter: ContentFilterKind.Bm25, maxDepth: 1 };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages?.length);
}

void main();
```
